subject: mathematics
question_text: If A = {a, b, c, d, e} and B = {a, c, f, g, h}, find the symmetric difference of A and B.

recall_prompt: Say how you would work this out — say what you find first, and how you know the answer has the right number of elements.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Find the two differences
steps.margin_note: First mark. Write A ∩ B first. The same two shared letters are then removed from both sets, so one reading of the lists does both differences.
lines: A = {a, b, c, d, e},   B = {a, c, f, g, h}
The letters in both sets are  A ∩ B = {a, c}
A − B = {b, d, e}    (a and c removed from A)
B − A = {f, g, h}    (a and c removed from B)

recall.must_convey: That the shared letters are a and c, so A − B = {b, d, e} and B − A = {f, g, h}.
accept: a and c are common so A minus B is b d e and B minus A is f g h
remove the common letters from each set separately
find the intersection first then take both differences
common ga unnavi a and c so vaatini rendintilo nunchi theeyali
b d e from the first and f g h from the second

steps.why: Both differences are needed and each is built by removing the same two shared letters, so writing the intersection once prevents the same slip being made twice.
steps.memory_tip: Find what the two sets share first; the symmetric difference is everything else.
common_mistakes: Writing A − B = {b, d, e, f, g, h}, which mixes in letters that belong to B.
Removing a and c from A but forgetting to remove them from B.

steps.label: Take their union
steps.margin_note: Second mark. The two differences share nothing, so the union is the two lists joined. Six letters, each written once.
lines: Check: A ∪ B has 8 letters and A ∩ B has 2, and 8 − 2 = 6.

lines.text: ∴ A Δ B = {b, d, e, f, g, h}

recall.must_convey: That the union of the two differences is {b, d, e, f, g, h}, six letters.
accept: join the two differences to get b d e f g h
the answer has six letters and a and c are not in it
union of the two differences is the symmetric difference
rendu differences ni kalipithe b d e f g h vasthundi
eight minus two is six so six letters
heard_as: b d e f g h

steps.why: The count n(A ∪ B) − n(A ∩ B) = 8 − 2 = 6 is an independent check on the list, so a missed letter shows up before the answer is boxed.
steps.memory_tip: Count first: the answer must have n(A ∪ B) − n(A ∩ B) elements.
common_mistakes: Including a and c, which turns the answer into A ∪ B.
Writing a letter twice because it was copied from both differences.
Giving only A − B = {b, d, e} and stopping.
